categories.title: Community Discussion: Token Utility Concerns, Developer Outreach, and Project Activity

content.text: In the general discussion channel, a community member raised concerns about previously promised token-based utility that has not been delivered, questioning whether those statements were genuine or still planned. Another community member responded that users can add utility to the token and earn it. Separately, a developer posted asking if anyone was looking to hire a developer, which was met with hostility from another user who dismissed the request and made negative remarks about the project's development team. A different user then posted a detailed profile advertising their skills as a Senior AI and ML Full-Stack Engineer, highlighting experience with LLMs, agentic AI, RAG, automation, and various frameworks including LangGraph and OpenAI Agents SDK, with a background delivering AI products in Finance, Healthcare, and SaaS.

In the coders channel, a helper asked MochinoLabs whether the team had been in contact with them. MochinoLabs confirmed no contact had been made and asked where the getting started documentation was available online. The conversation moved to direct messages, though MochinoLabs later requested that communication return to the public channel or cease entirely.

In the partners channel, a community member with Partner and Vanguard roles noted signs of progress in the project repository, describing increased activity, models learning, harnesses merging, and suggesting that a significant development effort is underway.
